answers.text: I have fourteen years in operations, the last seven as regional operations director across five countries with about 120 staff. The decision I am proudest of was consolidating two regional warehouses into one hub, which helped bring average order-to-delivery time down from nine days to six. I am applying for an executive MBA now because I run operations well, but I have never had to set the financial and strategic trade-offs for the whole business.
I cannot share the cost of the hub or the company's revenue for the region. Those figures are confidential. I can talk about how we weighed the options.
I believe in empowering my people and creating a culture of excellence. I always lead from the front and keep everyone aligned to the vision.
I do not know the exact headcount reduction from the consolidation. HR handled that, and I was not given the final figure.
I think I have given you enough for today. Can we stop here, please?
